headline: From Ish to Jared Leto: Hollywood’s Dark Secret – the week in rave reviews
context: A poetic coming-of-age tale haunted by racial profiling among the Asian community in Luton, while a BBC documentary unearths troubling allegations against the high-profile celeb. Here’s the pick of the week’s culture, taken from the Guardian’s best-rated reviews Continue reading.
